title: Kronos Engine v1.0.0 — Research Artifact for JAMIA 2026 Manuscript
description: Frozen research artifact accompanying the JAMIA 2026 manuscript 'Kronos Engine: A Deterministic Counterfactual Experimentation Platform with Sentinel Adapter Pattern for Multi-Scale Health System Simulation'. Contains source code (TypeScript, zero runtime dependencies), frozen experiment artifacts (P-003 WWII counterfactual with 30 seeds, P-004 Deers Rock sentinel with 30 seeds, Phase F causal-null replication with 5 seeds), the final manuscript, and documentation required for reviewer inspection and reproduction. Commit 4d7e4128f6ad800fa762f443f36aa4f45d31e4d9, tag baseline-pre-reopen.
